resource: ATTACK_TARGET_INTENT commands (command type 11) of one GameSession
allocation_impact: A per-GameSession sliding window of at most 25 target change instants in any 1 s, carried in the session continuity so a reconnect, resume or transfer never resets it. Each accepted command changes one runtime field and sends one domain 10 delta of at most 39 bytes, so a session costs at most 25 changes and about 1 KB of deltas per second. An over-rate command has no effect and gets CommandStatus REJECTED with an empty payload.
boundary_tests: max=25: 25 target changes in one second are applied
max+1=26: a 26th target change in the same second is REJECTED without effect, also after a reconnect; one a second later is applied
consumers: apps/game-server/src/gameplay_transport/attack.rs IntentWindow: the dispatch of command type 11 enforces the window
notes: ATTACK-0 §3 and ARCH-CORE-LOOP-PACKETS-2 §2.1. The value is Canary's own bound: config.lua.dist maxPacketsPerSecond = 25 caps every client packet of one connection, and ProtocolGame::parseAttack (0xA1) and parseFightModes (0xA0) have no tighter per-action limit, so no Canary-faithful client sends more. The oteryn-protocol-oteryn test attack::tests::the_registries_bind_the_attack_constants binds this row to the constant; the game-server test gameplay_transport::attack::tests enforces it.
